_comment: Read by the app (see MPTree-App/src/updateCheck.ts) to tell people on an older build that a newer one exists. Keep it in step with the top entry of assets/versions.js, which is what the website itself renders. Only the build handed out by this website checks this file; the Play Store build never does.
notes: Swapping between Songs and Playlists no longer nudges the list you were reading.
The collapse button can be dragged anywhere you like while the header is folded.
Naming a new playlist works. The box used to open behind the header card.
Everything that folds away now folds at the same rate.
The equaliser shows a level either side of zero instead of five white blocks.
